title: Backflow test frequency: verify the program rule for your assembly
description: Testing frequency is established by the governing program and can vary by utility, connection, or notice.
prompt: How often is this exact assembly required to be tested?
answer: Testing frequency is established by the governing program and can vary by utility, connection, or notice. Use the official record and current asset identity, rather than an assumed annual cadence.
urgency: Escalate contradictory notices, missing program information, or a device that does not match the stated requirement.
identifiers: The issuer controls frequency and due basis.
Each assembly record needs its own last test and next required action.
A changed device or property record may alter the compliance workflow.
